query: Why do some incidents take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: resolution_hours
per_column.rationale: This is the direct target metric of the query -- time to resolve. Derivable from opened_at and closed_at. Values are plausibly warranted (elapsed time between timestamps); the many NULLs correctly reflect unresolved/open incidents. Highly useful as the outcome variable.

per_column.name: priority_numeric
per_column.rationale: Numeric extraction of the existing priority field enables grouping/correlation with resolution time, a plausible driver. Slightly redundant with the original priority column but adds modeling convenience; well grounded.

per_column.name: category_mismatch
per_column.rationale: A flag for whether the short_description conflicts with the assigned category could plausibly relate to slower resolution (misrouting). However, groundedness is uncertain: judging a 'mismatch' requires a subjective mapping, and sample rows (e.g. 'Email system not working' flagged 1 without visible category) make the derivation hard to verify.

per_column.name: opened_hour
per_column.rationale: Hour of day opened is a reasonable axis (off-hours tickets may resolve slower). Grounded in opened_at. Minor concern: sample rows show opened_hour values that don't obviously match the shown timestamps (only sys_updated_on/closed_at shown), but opened_at exists in the table so derivation is plausible.

per_column.name: opened_day_of_week
per_column.rationale: Day-of-week gives a genuine grouping axis for resolution-time differences (weekday vs weekend staffing). Derivable from opened_at and consistent with is_weekend in samples.

per_column.name: is_weekend
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to resolution delays, but largely redundant with opened_day_of_week (a restatement/derivative). Well grounded and consistent with the day-of-week values in samples.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide the core outcome variable (resolution_hours) plus several plausible explanatory axes (priority, timing, category mismatch) that directly serve the 'why do some incidents take longer' query. Most are well grounded in existing timestamp/priority fields. Weaknesses: is_weekend is largely a derivative of opened_day_of_week, and category_mismatch relies on a subjective derivation that is hard to verify from the samples. No clear hallucinations observed.
